decisions.statement: Every error in the file is judged before any error is carried up.
An error is judged stale against the latest moment any error in the file was seen.
Every addon is judged as though outside the repository.
Recency alone makes an error stale.
An error unseen for twenty-four hours is stale.
A caller may name another span in place of the twenty-four hours.
An error left unjudged is carried up rather than held back.
The cursor is saved before any line reaches the log.
How many errors were held back is logged before any error is logged.
Every error carried up is logged as one line of json.
The count of errors carried up is logged after every envelope.
A run with nothing up logs that nothing was new or had recurred.
One addon's build id file is read once for a whole run.
A caller may name the cursor file.
A caller may name the log.
A caller may name where a build id is read from.
The watcher's own log is written where the caller names no log.
Nothing here decides which errors are carried up.
Nothing here opens the saved errors file.

definition: the watcher's handling of a saved errors file, from reading it to logging what is new
